universe.selection: params: obscount>=200 & >=2 codes; pairs: co-observed>=300; lexicographic (Parameter_ID, i<j) truncated to first 4000
universe.note: probe bug fixed 05:33 (obsm[ok] row-select -> obsm[:,ok]); stats from fixed code/probe_p3.py

scope_resolutions: R1 scoring universe = all 17053 legal combos of the 4000 pairs; headline gap analysis on the 32 gaps
R2 bottom decile = bottom 10% of each model's support over the 17053 combos (1705 cells); consensus set = in >=4/6 models' bottom deciles
R3 item-1 Spearman reported on both the 32-gap set (frozen '空格全集') and the full 17053 set (added for power)
R4 CSV scope: global fit all 6 models x 17053 + seed-stability rows for C4_ldm only (5 x 17053); per-seed full support kept in-memory for Spearman, summarized in JSON (avoids ~200MB)
R5 prompt model section lists 6 models (C1/C3/C4/C5/C6/C7) but eval/output lines say '5'; resolved to all 6; pairwise = 15 pairs; consensus threshold >=4/6

models.C1_indep: P(ci,cj) = D1[pi,ci]*D1[pj,cj]; D1 = global Laplace add-1 marginal over all 2467 rows (P2 c1_dists convention, CODES non-zero-based)
models.C3_tree: score(ci,cj) = (1/n) sum_l [ (W@I)[l] - W[l,l]*I[l] + 1 ] / [ rowsum_excl_l + Ki*Kj ]; I[m]=1[combo_m==(ci,cj), both observed]; W[l,m] = exp(-3d(l,m))*(1+2*[same fam, neither NA])*(1+0.5*[same mac, neither NA]); d = 1-2*Lc/(LEN_l+LEN_m) (P2 lineage PREF/LEN); W (2467x2467 float64 ~49MB) computed once, cached results/_w_cache.npz
models.C4_ldm: soft-impute rank-3, 30 iters, missing init = C1 prob (global), seed 42 -> A3 (398,3); per language f_l = lstsq(A3[obs_slots_l], y_l), no obs -> D1 fallback; P(c|f_l) = max(0, a_{p,c}.f_l) normalized over codes of p (latent conditional-independence approx, noted); score(ci,cj) = (1/n) sum_l P(ci|f_l)*P(cj|f_l)
models.C5_graph: per pair: P0 = (C+1)/(n_pair+Ki*Kj) (Laplace +1); fit log P0 ~= alpha_i + beta_j + u_i*v_j (rank-1 bilinear) by ALS 100 rounds; init rng=default_rng(42) per pair: v~N(0,0.1,Kj), u=0, alpha=rowmean(log P0), beta=0; convergence flag = max param change < 1e-10; support = softmax(alpha+beta+u v) over pair grid
models.C6_manifold: one-hot (n,398) missing->0 (noted convention); TSNE(perplexity=30, init='pca', random_state=42, n_iter=1000, early_exaggeration=4) -> emb (n,2); ybar = mean(emb); ybar_p(c) = mean emb of languages observed with (p,c) (empty set -> contribution 0); xhat = ybar_pi(ci)+ybar_pj(cj)-ybar; support = mean_l exp(-||xhat-emb_l||^2/(2 sigma^2)), sigma = median NN distance (NearestNeighbors k=2)
models.C7_energy: rate = (count+1)/(n_pair+Ki*Kj); rate_indep = D1[pi,ci]*D1[pj,cj] (global C1); E = clip(-ln(rate/rate_indep), -ln50, ln50); support = exp(-E)/sum over pair grid

evaluation.item1_agreement: pairwise Spearman (15 pairs) on 32-gap set and full 17053 set; consensus low-support set per R2; report size, n_true_gaps_in_consensus, C4 rank (min/median/max) of consensus cells within full set
evaluation.item2_seed_stability: 5 random splits (pilot0 config seeds 42-46, train = all - held 493); refit per model on train (C1 marginal, C3 W on train rows, C4 soft-impute refit, C5 ALS on train counts, C6 TSNE on train rows, C7 rates on train counts); score same 17053 universe; per model = mean of 10 pairwise cross-seed Spearman; ④ TRIGGER if any model mean < 0.5
evaluation.item3_rare_calibration: 484 rare cells (count 1-10, global counts); soft label y = (count+1)/(n_pair+Ki*Kj); per model: logloss (p clipped [1e-12, 1-1e-12]; C6 is a density, clipping noted), brier, Spearman(support, log(count+1)), false_low_rate = fraction of count>=50 cells (14726) in model bottom decile (expect ~0); ⑤ TRIGGER (P3 proxy, noted) if any model false_low_rate > 0.10 or Spearman(support, log(count+1)) < 0.5
evaluation.item4_abstention: abstention set = model bottom 10% over 17053 (R2); report |abstention|, Jaccard vs consensus set, abstention ∩ true gaps count

hypothesis_mapping: H4 (calibration) -> item3; falsification ④ (stability) -> item2 threshold 0.5; falsification ⑤ (calibration) -> item3 proxy above
